We introduce \textbf{SWE-bench Science}, a repository-level benchmark for scientific software engineering comprising 119 tasks from 98 GitHub repositories across 20 scientific domains. Each task is organized into one of three paradigms: Issue-driven, Expert-exploratory, and Engineering-integration. Even the best-performing agent, \textbf{Claude Code with Opus-5 (max), achieves a pass@1 below 50\%}, highlighting the substantial challenges posed by scientific software engineering. We identify four recurring failure mechanisms: deficits in scientific knowledge or abstraction, misguided exploration or surface-level repair, incomplete repair coverage or system integration, and failures to generalize scientific knowledge beyond observed cases in our analysis. We further conduct a paired ablation that removes explicit scientific guidance while preserving the repository and executable engineering context. The results show that scientific knowledge is not uniformly beneficial: well-grounded information can constrain repair and improve average performance and token efficiency, whereas poorly aligned guidance can induce anchoring and does not necessarily improve exact repair success. Together, SWE-bench Science provides a broad testbed for studying both the capabilities and failure mechanisms of coding agents in scientific software engineering.

摘要：軟體越來越多地作為科學儀器本身的一部分運作，使得科學代碼中的故障不僅可能影響程式行為，還可能損害科學結論背後的證據。然而，現有的編碼代理評估主要強調整體任務成功率，對於代理在修復科學軟體時為何失敗提供的見解有限。我們介紹了 \textbf{SWE-bench Science}，這是一個針對科學軟體工程的庫級基準，包含來自20個科學領域的98個GitHub庫中的119個任務。每個任務被組織為三種範式之一：問題驅動、專家探索和工程整合。即使是表現最佳的代理，\textbf{Claude Code with Opus-5 (max) 的通過率低於50\%}，突顯了科學軟體工程所帶來的重大挑戰。我們識別出四種重複出現的失敗機制：科學知識或抽象的不足、誤導性的探索或表面修復、不完整的修復覆蓋或系統整合，以及在我們的分析中未能將科學知識概括到觀察案例之外的失敗。我們進一步進行了一次配對消融，去除明確的科學指導，同時保留庫和可執行的工程背景。結果顯示，科學知識並非均有益處：良好的信息可以限制修復並提高平均性能和標記效率，而不良的指導則可能導致錨定，並不一定提高精確修復的成功率。總體而言，SWE-bench Science 提供了一個廣泛的測試平台，用於研究科學軟體工程中編碼代理的能力和失敗機制。

docs.title: Towards general embodied intelligence: integrating large language models, knowledge bases, and reasoning capabilities to build the next generation of AI agents
docs.text:
2608.19794v1 by Fujiang Yuan, Xia Huang, Lusheng Wang, Jun Ding, Zhen Tian, Yuxin Wang, Shaojie Gu, Yuki Funabora, Yanhong Peng, Zebing Mao

The convergence of large language models (LLMs), structured knowledge bases (KBs), and reasoning ability (RA) presents a promising trajectory toward general embodied intelligence (GEI). This paper reviews the evolution of LLM-centered intelligent systems, emphasising their integration with knowledge representation, logical reasoning, and physical embodiment. We analyse LLM architectures, pre-training methods, and inference mechanisms, along with their interaction with external knowledge sources and structured reasoning frameworks. Furthermore, we examine embodied intelligence (EI) paradigms wherein agents learn and act in physical environments. To synthesise these dimensions, we present a conceptual framework that illustrates the synergy among LLMs, KBs, RA, and embodiment, serving as a guiding model for perception, reasoning, and action rather than an implemented engineering architecture. To advance toward GEI, we identify five key challenges: efficient LLM deployment, closed-loop knowledge integration, hybrid symbolic-neural reasoning, perception-action grounding, and continual learning. This survey provides a comprehensive roadmap for developing adaptive, multimodal agents capable of operating in complex, dynamic settings.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）、結構化知識庫（KBs）和推理能力（RA）的融合展現了通往一般具身智慧（GEI）的有希望的發展路徑。本文回顧了以LLM為中心的智能系統的演變，強調它們與知識表示、邏輯推理和物理具身的整合。我們分析了LLM架構、預訓練方法和推理機制，以及它們與外部知識來源和結構化推理框架的互動。此外，我們檢視了具身智慧（EI）範式，其中代理在物理環境中學習和行動。為了綜合這些維度，我們提出了一個概念框架，說明LLMs、KBs、RA和具身之間的協同作用，作為感知、推理和行動的指導模型，而非實施的工程架構。為了向GEI邁進，我們確定了五個關鍵挑戰：高效的LLM部署、閉環知識整合、混合符號-神經推理、感知-行動基礎和持續學習。本調查提供了一個全面的路線圖，以發展能夠在複雜動態環境中運作的自適應多模態代理。

docs.title: GenMatch: An End-to-End Generative Matching Framework for Micro-View Order-Dispatching in Ride-Hailing
docs.text:
2608.19751v1 by Chuang Liu, Yuxueqing Zhang, Tengfei Lyu, Zirui Yuan, Weiqi Hu, Yanghan Cheng, Ming Wang, Li Ma, Zihao Lu

Micro-View Order-Dispatching assigns available drivers to passenger orders within each dispatch batch and is critical to the service quality and operational efficiency of ride-hailing platforms. Mainstream industrial solutions follow a multi-stage paradigm of model prediction, value calculation, and dispatch matching. Although dispatch quality is determined by the final batch-level assignment, these stages optimize different intermediate objectives. This cross-stage objective inconsistency means that improving a single stage does not necessarily improve the overall dispatch result. We therefore formulate Micro-View Order-Dispatching as a generative matching problem and propose GenMatch, an end-to-end Generative Matching framework and the first such framework deployed in a real-world production environment. Applying generative modeling to this problem introduces three challenges. First, each dispatch batch forms a dynamic sparse bipartite graph, requiring efficient structured batch-level encoding. Second, replacing the hand-crafted value function requires learning unified business utility from heterogeneous feedback. Third, directly generating an assignment requires tracking the evolving matching state because each selected order-driver pair changes the remaining feasible candidates. GenMatch addresses these challenges with a Context-Aware Bipartite Encoder, a Business-Aware Utility Learner, and a State-Aware Pointer Decoder. Extensive offline evaluations and online A/B tests in five cities across DiDi's international ride-hailing markets show consistent improvements over competitive baselines, confirming the effectiveness and practicality of GenMatch for industrial order-dispatching.

摘要：微觀訂單派遣在每個派遣批次中將可用司機分配給乘客訂單，對於叫車平台的服務質量和運營效率至關重要。主流的工業解決方案遵循多階段的模型預測、價值計算和派遣匹配的範式。儘管派遣質量由最終的批次級分配決定，但這些階段優化不同的中間目標。這種跨階段目標不一致意味著改善單一階段不一定會改善整體派遣結果。因此，我們將微觀訂單派遣表述為一個生成匹配問題，並提出GenMatch，一個端到端的生成匹配框架，也是第一個在真實生產環境中部署的此類框架。將生成建模應用於此問題引入了三個挑戰。首先，每個派遣批次形成一個動態稀疏二部圖，需要高效的結構化批次級編碼。其次，替換手工製作的價值函數需要從異質反饋中學習統一的商業效用。第三，直接生成分配需要追踪不斷演變的匹配狀態，因為每個選定的訂單-司機對會改變剩餘的可行候選者。GenMatch通過上下文感知的二部編碼器、商業感知的效用學習器和狀態感知的指針解碼器來解決這些挑戰。在DiDi的國際叫車市場的五個城市中進行的廣泛離線評估和在線A/B測試顯示出相對於競爭基準的一致改進，確認了GenMatch在工業訂單派遣中的有效性和實用性。

docs.title: Frequency-Aware Continual Learning for Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection with Large Language Models
docs.text:
2608.19680v1 by Tenghui Huang, Jiawen Kang, Dongning Liu, Changyan Yi, Chengjun Cai, Anjia Yang, Li Li, Dong In Kim

Smart contract vulnerability detection with Large Language Models (LLMs) faces three causally linked challenges. First, new vulnerability categories demand parameter-efficient adaptation, since full retraining is prohibitive for sequentially arriving tasks. Second, training per-task adapters on a shared backbone causes catastrophic forgetting of previously learned vulnerabilities. Third, the resulting multiplicity of adapters must be consolidated into a single model, since task identity is unknown at inference time. Each challenge arises directly from the solution to its predecessor, making an integrated framework essential. We propose a three-stage pipeline in which each stage addresses one challenge and feeds into the next. The adaptation stage uses Frequency-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation (FA-LoRA), which performs adaptation in the Fourier domain with per-frequency importance gates, requiring only 0.4% trainable parameters while outperforming standard LoRA and QLoRA. The continual learning stage applies Forget-Aware Replay (FAR), which uses these frequency gates to estimate per-sample forgetting risk via loss dynamics and prioritizes vulnerable knowledge for rehearsal, achieving an average Micro-F1 of 0.8022 across sequential tasks. The deployment stage employs Anchor-Protected Progressive Merging (APPM), which exploits the asymmetric generalization produced by FAR training to identify the strongest-generalizing adapter as an anchor and consolidates all adapters into a single model via anchor-protected weighted merging with frequency-domain gate competition. APPM achieves a Micro-F1 of 0.8085, within 2.7% of the independent per-task upper bound, at a merge cost of 156 ms and no additional runtime memory. Experiments on DIVE confirm the framework effectively addresses all three challenges for evolving blockchain ecosystems.

摘要：智慧合約漏洞檢測與大型語言模型（LLMs）面臨三個因果相關的挑戰。首先，新的漏洞類別需要參數高效的適應，因為對於連續到達的任務，全面重新訓練是不可行的。其次，在共享骨幹上對每個任務適配器進行訓練會導致先前學習的漏洞的災難性遺忘。第三，產生的多個適配器必須整合成一個單一模型，因為在推理時任務身份是未知的。每個挑戰都是直接源自其前一個挑戰的解決方案，使得一個綜合框架變得至關重要。我們提出了一個三階段的管道，其中每個階段解決一個挑戰並為下一個階段提供支持。適應階段使用頻率感知低秩適應（FA-LoRA），它在傅立葉域中進行適應，並使用每個頻率的重要性閘，僅需0.4%的可訓練參數，同時超越標準的LoRA和QLoRA。持續學習階段應用遺忘感知重放（FAR），它利用這些頻率閘通過損失動態來估計每個樣本的遺忘風險，並優先考慮脆弱知識進行重演，在連續任務中達到平均Micro-F1為0.8022。部署階段使用錨點保護漸進合併（APPM），它利用FAR訓練產生的非對稱泛化來識別最強泛化的適配器作為錨點，並通過錨點保護的加權合併與頻率域閘競爭將所有適配器整合成一個單一模型。APPM在合併成本為156毫秒且無額外運行時內存的情況下，達到了Micro-F1為0.8085，距離獨立每任務的上限僅有2.7%。在DIVE上的實驗證實了該框架有效解決了針對不斷演變的區塊鏈生態系統的所有三個挑戰。

docs.title: The Asymmetric Harms of LLM Compression
docs.text:
2608.19670v1 by Yuan Wu, Mairui Li, Lesia Semenova, Chudi Zhong

Large language models (LLMs) compression reduces deployment costs, but standard aggregate metrics like perplexity and accuracy often mask underlying behavioral shifts. In this work, we systematically evaluate 3 LLMs across 11 compression methods to investigate the effects of compression on knowledge retention, model confidence, and social bias. We find that compression disproportionately reduces the relative retention of head knowledge compared to tail knowledge. Furthermore, compressed models often remain substantially confident in their incorrect answers on newly lost knowledge. Finally, we demonstrate that stable aggregate bias scores can conceal substantial, opposing shifts in stereotypical preferences across demographic subgroups. Together, these findings reveal asymmetric behavioral changes that aggregate performance measures fail to capture, highlighting the need for granular evaluation of compressed models before deployment.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）的壓縮降低了部署成本，但像困惑度和準確度這樣的標準綜合指標往往掩蓋了潛在的行為變化。在這項工作中，我們系統地評估了3個LLM在11種壓縮方法下的表現，以調查壓縮對知識保留、模型信心和社會偏見的影響。我們發現，壓縮不成比例地減少了頭部知識相對於尾部知識的保留。此外，壓縮模型通常對其在新丟失知識上的錯誤答案仍然保持相當的信心。最後，我們展示了穩定的綜合偏見分數可能掩蓋了不同人口子群中刻板印象偏好方面的重大對立變化。這些發現共同揭示了綜合性能指標未能捕捉的不對稱行為變化，突顯了在部署前對壓縮模型進行細緻評估的必要性。

docs.title: Scientific Data Skills: Enabling Agent-Ready Scientific Data Services at Scale
docs.text:
2608.19625v1 by Xiaohan Huang, Qingqing Long, Xiaolei Du, Siyu Pu, Jiawen Xu, Haotian Chen, Chenyang Zhao, Jinbiao Liu, Xuezhi Wang, Hao Wang, Hengshu Zhu, Yuanchun Zhou

Scientific data are increasingly used by AI agents, yet existing dataset representations provide limited support for autonomous discovery, interpretation, and invocation. This limitation stems from the fragmentation of scientific data across heterogeneous repositories and from dataset representations designed primarily for human use. To address this limitation, we introduce the Scientific Data Skill (SciDSK), an agent-ready representation that packages dataset-specific knowledge and operational guidance as a reusable agent skill. A SciDSK integrates dataset descriptions, scientific context, file organization, usage procedures, quality checks, and provenance information while retaining the underlying data in its original repository. We define a structured SciDSK specification and develop a systematic construction pipeline that grounds each SciDSK in authoritative dataset records and associated supporting materials. We further establish the Scientific Data Skill Bank, a unified platform that publishes SciDSK resources across six scientific disciplines and supports package access, persistent identification, and traceability to source datasets. We evaluate SciDSK through a retrieval benchmark for dataset discovery and controlled cases for dataset interpretation. The results show that SciDSK improves agent-driven dataset discovery and provides more precise and actionable support for dataset interpretation. These findings support the value of organizing dataset-specific knowledge in an agent-ready representation.

摘要：科學數據越來越多地被 AI 代理使用，但現有的數據集表示對於自主發現、解釋和調用的支持有限。這一限制源於科學數據在異構存儲庫中的碎片化，以及數據集表示主要為人類使用而設計。為了解決這一限制，我們引入了科學數據技能（SciDSK），這是一種為代理準備的表示，將數據集特定知識和操作指導打包為可重用的代理技能。SciDSK 整合了數據集描述、科學背景、文件組織、使用程序、質量檢查和來源信息，同時保留原始存儲庫中的底層數據。我們定義了一個結構化的 SciDSK 規範，並開發了一個系統化的構建管道，使每個 SciDSK 以權威的數據集記錄和相關支持材料為基礎。我們進一步建立了科學數據技能庫，這是一個統一平台，發布跨六個科學學科的 SciDSK 資源，並支持包訪問、持久識別和對源數據集的可追溯性。我們通過數據集發現的檢索基準和數據集解釋的受控案例來評估 SciDSK。結果顯示，SciDSK 改進了代理驅動的數據集發現，並為數據集解釋提供了更精確和可行的支持。這些發現支持將數據集特定知識組織成為代理準備的表示的價值。

docs.title: In Two Minds about Lifelong Learning: Exploring Hemispheric Redundancy and Specialisation in Neural Models
docs.text:
2608.19514v1 by Benjamin Smith, Levin Kuhlmann, Kaushik Roy, Gideon Kowadlo

Persistent intelligent systems require the ability to learn continually, but current machine learning approaches face significant challenges in this area compared to biological learning systems. Machine learning algorithms typically trade off retention of previously learned information and adaptation to new or changing data patterns. When continual learning capabilities are absent, algorithms must undergo retraining using the entire data set, an approach that becomes impractical when original training data are unavailable due to storage constraints, financial or computational costs, or privacy restrictions. However, biological animals can learn continually, without experiencing catastrophic forgetting. This paper attempts to build a high-level framework for how animals learn and preserve knowledge by modelling neural components and states that are known to be related to memory consolidation. We focus on three concepts: experience replay, REM sleep, and bilaterality. We propose 4MAS (4 Module Awake/Sleep), a novel macroarchitecture demonstrating how machine learning models might benefit from asymmetric hemispheres, each with their own long- and short-term memory mechanisms, and how a period of sleep between incremental learning tasks might benefit memory consolidation. Finally, we present results showing that our architecture achieves competitive results on the Split-MNIST, Split-Fashion-MNIST and Split-CIFAR-100 datasets, with 98.3%, 84.9%, and 29.29% accuracy respectively.

摘要：持續的智能系統需要具備持續學習的能力，但與生物學習系統相比，目前的機器學習方法在這方面面臨重大挑戰。機器學習算法通常在保留先前學習的信息和適應新的或變化的數據模式之間進行權衡。當缺乏持續學習能力時，算法必須使用整個數據集進行重新訓練，這種方法在原始訓練數據因存儲限制、財務或計算成本或隱私限制而無法獲得時變得不切實際。然而，生物動物可以持續學習，而不會經歷災難性的遺忘。本文試圖建立一個高層次的框架，說明動物如何學習和保留知識，通過建模已知與記憶鞏固相關的神經組件和狀態。我們專注於三個概念：經驗重播、REM睡眠和雙側性。我們提出4MAS（4個模塊的清醒/睡眠），這是一種新穎的宏觀架構，展示了機器學習模型如何從不對稱的半球中受益，每個半球都有自己的長期和短期記憶機制，以及在增量學習任務之間的睡眠期如何有助於記憶鞏固。最後，我們展示了結果，顯示我們的架構在Split-MNIST、Split-Fashion-MNIST和Split-CIFAR-100數據集上達到了具有競爭力的結果，準確率分別為98.3%、84.9%和29.29%。

docs.title: HARP: Hierarchical Adaptive Ranking with Preference-Adaptive Fusion for Query-Based CVE Prioritization
docs.text:
2608.19430v1 by Haochen Liu, Zhengzhang Chen, Haoyu Wang, Yanchi Liu, Jundong Li, Haifeng Chen

Vulnerability prioritization is inherently preference dependent, since the same CVE can receive different remediation priority under different operational preference scenarios. Existing scoring systems and ranking methods typically assume a fixed criterion. In practice, organizations already operate under a preference scenario, but this preference is often implicit and difficult to express as a written prompt instruction, while triage queries usually do not encode it. Past validated triage cases under the current scenario are more readily available. We study query-based CVE prioritization in this setting and propose HARP, a graph-grounded multi-view framework that ranks candidates from a natural-language query together with a support bank of historical labeled examples from the current preference scenario, without requiring an explicit textual summary of that scenario. HARP retrieves evidence from a vulnerability knowledge graph, scores candidates with policy-conditioned global, enterprise, and user views, and fits view-fusion weights from sampled supports. Experiments across three preference scenarios and multiple backbone LLMs show that HARP outperforms multiple baselines, expressing our method's effectiveness.

摘要：漏洞優先排序本質上依賴於偏好，因為相同的CVE在不同的操作偏好情境下可能會獲得不同的修復優先級。現有的評分系統和排名方法通常假設一個固定的標準。在實踐中，組織已經在一個偏好情境下運作，但這種偏好往往是隱含的，難以表達為書面提示指令，而分診查詢通常不會編碼它。在當前情境下，過去經過驗證的分診案例更容易獲得。我們在這種情境下研究基於查詢的CVE優先排序，並提出HARP，一個基於圖的多視角框架，該框架從自然語言查詢中排名候選者，並結合來自當前偏好情境的歷史標記示例的支持庫，而不需要該情境的明確文本摘要。HARP從漏洞知識圖中檢索證據，使用政策條件的全球、企業和用戶視角對候選者進行打分，並從抽樣支持中擬合視角融合權重。在三個偏好情境和多個骨幹LLM上的實驗顯示，HARP超越了多個基準，表現出我們方法的有效性。

docs.title: Pre-Compiled Pipeline Shards for Distributed LLM Inference on Intel AI PC Fleets
docs.text:
2608.19147v1 by Tate Berenbaum, Muthaiah Venkatachalam

Modern Intel AI PCs ship capable integrated GPUs and NPUs with 16+ GB of unified memory, and they spend considerable time idle. That is not enough memory to fit a large model such as a 70B-parameter LLM. We show that a handful of AIPCs, working together over an ordinary network, can serve models beyond the capability of any single one. We use pipeline parallelism: a model is split by layer into per-stage shards, each pre-compiled into an OpenVINO graph, so that every machine runs one shard and passes activations to the next. Three techniques make this fast enough to be useful. First, we recover the speed of the unsplit model: a naive per-stage export runs well below monolithic inference because it misses an OpenVINO GPU optimization, and injecting a beam_idx Gather into each shard triggers that optimization (the IndirectKVCache fusion) and brings the shards to parity. Second, we leverage speculative decoding on stateful OpenVINO models. Third, the pipeline serves several users at once by interleaving their requests across the stages, each request carrying its own cache (micro-batching). Together, a two-node Llama 3.1 8B INT4 pipeline serves two concurrent users at 1.79x the single-user throughput of the unsplit model on the same hardware, and the gap widens under simulated wide-area latency. The same design scales to a 70B model that no single fleet member can hold: a four-node deployment of Lunar Lake AI PCs on Intel Tiber Cloud serves a single user at interactive speed, with output token-for-token identical to the same four-node pipeline decoding without speculation. Code, raw benchmark logs, and reproduction scripts ship as a self-contained package at https://github.com/labscommunity/pipeline-sharded-inference-paper (in the top-level reproduction/ directory).

摘要：現代的 Intel AI PC 配備了具備 16GB 以上統一記憶體的整合 GPU 和 NPU，並且它們有相當多的時間處於閒置狀態。這樣的記憶體不足以容納像 70B 參數的 LLM 這樣的大型模型。我們展示了一小部分 AIPCs 在普通網絡上協同工作，可以服務超出任何單一 AIPC 能力的模型。我們使用管道並行性：將模型按層分割為每階段的碎片，每個碎片預先編譯為 OpenVINO 圖形，這樣每台機器運行一個碎片並將激活傳遞給下一個。三種技術使這一過程足夠快速以便實用。首先，我們恢復了未分割模型的速度：一個天真的每階段導出運行的速度遠低於單體推理，因為它錯過了 OpenVINO GPU 的優化，而在每個碎片中注入 beam_idx Gather 觸發了該優化（間接 KV 緩存融合），使得碎片達到平衡。其次，我們利用狀態開放的 OpenVINO 模型進行推測解碼。第三，管道通過在各階段交錯用戶的請求，同時服務多個用戶，每個請求攜帶自己的緩存（微批處理）。總體而言，兩個節點的 Llama 3.1 8B INT4 管道在相同硬體上以 1.79 倍於未分割模型的單用戶吞吐量服務兩個並發用戶，而在模擬的廣域延遲下，這一差距進一步擴大。同樣的設計可以擴展到單一艦隊成員無法容納的 70B 模型：四節點的 Lunar Lake AI PC 部署以互動速度服務單一用戶，輸出與相同的四節點管道解碼（無推測）逐字相同。代碼、原始基準日誌和重現腳本作為自包含包提供，網址為 https://github.com/labscommunity/pipeline-sharded-inference-paper（在頂層重現/目錄中）。

docs.title: Detecting Backdoors in Object Detection via Pre-NMS Prediction Distribution Shift
docs.text:
2608.19088v1 by Longtian Wang, Zhengyu Zhao, Chenhao Lin, Le Yang, Shiwei Wang, Yuhan Zhi, Xiaofei Xie, Chao Shen

Object detection models deployed in safety-critical applications remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks that cause targeted misbehaviors when a hidden trigger is present. Existing detection methods either rely on trigger inversion or exploit architecture-specific assumptions, and critically, representative existing methods fail to generalize reliably to scene-level attacks, where a single trigger induces anomalous behavior across all objects in the scene simultaneously. We present DistScan, a backdoor detection framework based on a simple but previously unexploited observation: backdoor injection systematically shifts a model's pre-NMS prediction class distribution away from its training class frequencies, even on clean inputs without any trigger present. DistScan aggregates intermediate class predictions over a clean validation set and flags a model as backdoored if the resulting distribution deviates significantly from the training class frequencies, requiring no model weight access, no trigger knowledge, and no additional training. Extensive experiments on MS-COCO and PASCAL VOC across two architectures and three scene-level attack scenarios demonstrate that DistScan substantially outperforms existing methods, improving average detection accuracy over the best-performing applicable baseline by 27.32 percentage points.

摘要：物體檢測模型在安全關鍵應用中仍然容易受到後門攻擊的影響，這些攻擊在存在隱藏觸發器時會導致目標性的不當行為。現有的檢測方法要麼依賴於觸發器反演，要麼利用特定於架構的假設，並且，現有的代表性方法在場景級攻擊中無法可靠地泛化，在這種情況下，單一觸發器會同時引發場景中所有物體的異常行為。我們提出了DistScan，一個基於一個簡單但之前未被利用的觀察的後門檢測框架：後門注入系統性地將模型的預NMS預測類別分佈從其訓練類別頻率中偏移，即使在沒有任何觸發器的乾淨輸入上也是如此。DistScan在乾淨的驗證集上聚合中間類別預測，並在結果分佈顯著偏離訓練類別頻率時將模型標記為後門，這不需要訪問模型權重、不需要觸發器知識，也不需要額外的訓練。在MS-COCO和PASCAL VOC上針對兩種架構和三種場景級攻擊場景進行的廣泛實驗表明，DistScan顯著超越現有方法，將平均檢測準確率提高了27.32個百分點，相較於最佳表現的適用基線。

docs.title: GS-VLA: Plug-and-Play Viewpoint Canonicalization for Frozen VLA Policies via Gaussian Splatting
docs.text:
2608.19066v1 by Yechan Park, HyunJin Kim

This paper proposes a lightweight, plug-and-play framework that improves robustness to viewpoint shifts in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies without policy retraining. To our knowledge, this is the first approach to directly leverage 3D Gaussian-based novel-view synthesis for observation-space adaptation in VLA policies. Current VLA performance relies on the implicit assumption that training and deployment camera configurations are identical. Our experiments show that even a small displacement of the camera mount can reduce the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark from about 90% to about 10% in the worst case. Prior approaches, such as large-scale fine-tuning or generative data augmentation, are computationally expensive and risk catastrophic forgetting. To address this, viewpoint shifts are reformulated as a localized novel-view synthesis problem. Under a Locality assumption, that camera perturbations remain within a small bounded region relative to the workspace, viewpoint normalization reduces to a scene- and policy-independent disocclusion task. Our work implements this idea with a 4M-parameter 3D-Gaussian canonicalizer prepended to a frozen VLA policy. Without modifying policy weights, GS-VLA improves performance across three orthogonal axes: (1) Policy architectures, (2) Unseen task suites, and (3) Perturbation scales. These results show that a lightweight visual module can recover a large fraction of the performance lost under viewpoint shift, without policy retraining.

摘要：這篇論文提出了一個輕量級的即插即用框架，能在不重新訓練政策的情況下提高對視角變化的穩健性，應用於視覺-語言-行動（VLA）政策。據我們所知，這是第一個直接利用基於3D高斯的新視角合成來進行VLA政策觀察空間適應的方法。目前的VLA性能依賴於訓練和部署相機配置相同的隱含假設。我們的實驗顯示，即使是相機支架的微小位移，也能在最糟情況下將LIBERO基準的成功率從約90%降低至約10%。先前的方法，如大規模微調或生成數據增強，計算成本高昂且存在災難性遺忘的風險。為了解決這個問題，視角變化被重新表述為一個局部的新視角合成問題。在一個局部性假設下，即相機擾動保持在相對於工作空間的小範圍內，視角正規化簡化為一個場景和政策無關的去遮擋任務。我們的工作實現了這一思想，使用了一個4M參數的3D高斯標準化器，前置於一個凍結的VLA政策上。在不修改政策權重的情況下，GS-VLA在三個正交軸上提高了性能：（1）政策架構，（2）未見任務套件，以及（3）擾動尺度。這些結果顯示，輕量級的視覺模塊可以在不重新訓練政策的情況下，恢復在視角變化下損失的大部分性能。

docs.title: Eureka: Task-Conditioned Meta-Agent Orchestration for Scientific Discovery
docs.text:
2608.19047v1 by Alizer Wong, Heng Cui, Yi Tan, Xiongchao Zhan, Liang Lin, Yuxiang Guo, Zhaorong Dai, Zixin Zeng, Wenyuan Li

We present Eureka, a task-conditioned Meta-Agent architecture that compiles long-horizon tasks into dynamic obligation graphs with explicit acceptance semantics. During execution, Eureka forms Macro-Agents with specialized state, memory, operators, tools, verifiers, and local topology via receding-horizon planning, architecture promotion, and minimal-sufficient compilation. When bottlenecks recur, cost-benefit-gated evolution updates the local architecture under constraints. Theoretically, we establish results on regret, planning invalidation, amortization, subtree interfaces, serializability, and verification. Experimentally, Eureka completes 170/170 recursive tasks and generates 3,948 certificates with no false acceptances. Active context compresses median input from 9,490 to 4,005 tokens; incremental processing avoids 65.38% recomputation across 12,000 tasks; 16,000 concurrent executions serialize consistently. The same Meta-Agent instantiates a Theory-Discovery Agent and a Math/Conjecture Agent. The former yields structural results in quantum-process and spacetime theory. The latter identifies bottlenecks in Riemann Hypothesis research and advances a positivity certificate for Suzuki's localized Weil quadratic form to 0 < a <= 69/200 = 0.345, reaching ~99.55% of (log 2)/2. These results suggest that scientific-agent capability depends not only on the base model but on whether an architecture can be formed to match the task's cognitive structure.

摘要：我們提出了Eureka，一種任務條件的Meta-Agent架構，將長期任務編譯成具有明確接受語義的動態義務圖。在執行過程中，Eureka通過逐步規劃、架構推廣和最小充分編譯形成具有專門狀態、記憶、操作符、工具、驗證器和局部拓撲的宏代理。當瓶頸重現時，成本效益門檻進化在約束下更新本地架構。在理論上，我們建立了有關後悔、規劃失效、攤銷、子樹介面、可序列化性和驗證的結果。在實驗中，Eureka完成了170/170的遞歸任務，並生成了3,948個證書，沒有錯誤接受。主動上下文將中位數輸入從9,490壓縮到4,005個標記；增量處理避免了在12,000個任務中65.38%的重新計算；16,000個並發執行一致地序列化。相同的Meta-Agent實例化了一個理論發現代理和一個數學/猜想代理。前者在量子過程和時空理論中產生結構性結果。後者識別了黎曼假設研究中的瓶頸，並推進了鈴木的局部魏爾二次型的正性證書至0 < a <= 69/200 = 0.345，達到約99.55%的(log 2)/2。這些結果表明，科學代理的能力不僅依賴於基礎模型，還取決於是否能形成與任務的認知結構相匹配的架構。

docs.title: Adaptive Memory and Reflection Multi-Agent System for Medical Question Answering
docs.text:
2608.19029v1 by Pradeep Murugesan, Luoxiao Yang, Xueli Chen, Xinqi Fan

Accurate and responsible medical question answering (QA) is important in healthcare, where complex cases require factual knowledge and nuanced reasoning. Existing medical QA systems, typically based on single-agent architectures and static retrieval, often lack adaptability, persistent memory, and structured decision-making. This work introduces an adaptive memory and reflection (AMR) agentic system, a multi-agent framework in which specialized agents use dedicated memory and reflection-based feedback to retrieve relevant prior cases and improve subsequent reasoning. Complexity assessment routes questions through solo, collaborative, or escalated workflows, while consensus and ethical overseer modules support reasoning consolidation and output review. Evaluation on MedQA and MedMCQA demonstrates strong performance compared with several baselines. Ablation studies show that combining agent-specific memory, reflection, and external retrieval yields the strongest performance. These findings highlight the potential of structured memory and feedback for developing more trustworthy medical agents. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/mm-air/AMR-Agent.

摘要：準確且負責任的醫療問題回答（QA）在醫療保健中至關重要，因為複雜的案例需要事實知識和細緻的推理。現有的醫療QA系統通常基於單一代理架構和靜態檢索，往往缺乏適應性、持久記憶和結構化決策。這項工作介紹了一種自適應記憶和反思（AMR）代理系統，這是一個多代理框架，其中專門的代理使用專用記憶和基於反思的反饋來檢索相關的先前案例並改善後續推理。複雜性評估將問題路由到單獨、協作或升級的工作流程，而共識和倫理監督模塊則支持推理整合和輸出審查。在MedQA和MedMCQA上的評估顯示與幾個基準相比，表現強勁。消融研究表明，結合代理特定的記憶、反思和外部檢索可產生最強的性能。這些發現突顯了結構化記憶和反饋在開發更可信的醫療代理中的潛力。源代碼可在 https://github.com/mm-air/AMR-Agent 獲得。

docs.title: From Threat Intelligence to Detection: Knowledge-driven Enrichment and Template-based Rule Grounding for Automated Sigma Rule Generation
docs.text:
2608.19011v1 by Sepehr Ghaffarzadegan, Boubakr Nour, Makan Pourzandi, Mourad Debbabi, Chadi Assi

Mechanisms for dynamically converting cyber threat intelligence (CTI) into actionable detection capabilities are necessary due to the rapid evolution of Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs). Sigma rules are an essential part of contemporary threat detection workflows because they offer a platform-independent framework for expressing detection logic that can be converted into particular queries across SIEM systems. Conventional techniques for manually crafting Sigma rules are prone to mistakes, and necessitate extensive knowledge, which restricts their scalability. Although there are open-source and industry-maintained Sigma rule repositories, they often fail to keep pace with emerging threats and require frequent customization to fit diverse operational environments. This emphasizes the necessity of dynamic rule generation that is adapted to evolving attack techniques as well as particular use cases. In this work, we design AUTOSIGMA, an automated solution for transforming unstructured CTI reports into relevant Sigma rules. Rather than relying solely on language models, AUTOSIGMA leverages a structured knowledge base to enrich partial inputs, matches the enriched content against a repository of existing Sigma rules, and then employs an LLM-as-a-Judge mechanism to iteratively validate the rules. By combining knowledge-driven enrichment, template-based rule grounding, and a multi-stage solution, AUTOSIGMA enables accurate, context-aware, and relevant rule generation. Evaluations across multiple real-world APT reports and multiple security blogs demonstrate that AUTOSIGMA outperforms alternative solutions and LLM models in rule validity, rule relevancy, MITRE ATT&CK technique coverage, and robustness to input quality. AUTOSIGMA's Demo: https://youtu.be/iSr6IurQ6BM

摘要：由於先進持續威脅（APTs）的快速演變，動態將網絡威脅情報（CTI）轉換為可行的檢測能力的機制是必要的。Sigma 規則是當代威脅檢測工作流程中不可或缺的一部分，因為它們提供了一個平台無關的框架，用於表達檢測邏輯，這些邏輯可以轉換為跨 SIEM 系統的特定查詢。傳統手動編寫 Sigma 規則的技術容易出錯，並且需要廣泛的知識，這限制了它們的可擴展性。儘管有開源和行業維護的 Sigma 規則庫，但它們通常無法跟上新興威脅的步伐，並且需要頻繁的定制以適應多樣的操作環境。這強調了根據不斷演變的攻擊技術和特定用例調整的動態規則生成的必要性。在這項工作中，我們設計了 AUTOSIGMA，一個將非結構化 CTI 報告轉換為相關 Sigma 規則的自動化解決方案。AUTOSIGMA 不僅依賴於語言模型，而是利用結構化知識庫來豐富部分輸入，將豐富的內容與現有 Sigma 規則庫進行匹配，然後使用 LLM-as-a-Judge 機制來迭代驗證規則。通過結合知識驅動的豐富、基於模板的規則基礎以及多階段解決方案，AUTOSIGMA 能夠實現準確、上下文感知和相關的規則生成。對多個現實世界 APT 報告和多個安全博客的評估表明，AUTOSIGMA 在規則有效性、規則相關性、MITRE ATT&CK 技術覆蓋率和對輸入質量的穩健性方面優於其他解決方案和 LLM 模型。 AUTOSIGMA 的演示：https://youtu.be/iSr6IurQ6BM

docs.title: GrabVG: Graph-Attentive Binding for Visual Grounding in UAV Imagery
docs.text:
2608.18996v1 by Chaowei Wang, Yan Di, Jingjun Sun, Baozhe Liu, Jiaxu Tian, Yuheng Li, Guangqian Guo, Shan Gao

Visual grounding in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery aims to localize a target object in complex bird's-eye-view scenes according to a natural language description. However, the abundance of small, densely distributed, and visually similar objects creates high visual redundancy, while repetitive local configurations give rise to strong topological ambiguity. Existing approaches mainly focus on visual--language feature alignment or dense contextual interaction, yet they struggle to distinguish subtle inter-instance differences and effectively exploit spatial topological structures, leading to inaccurate grounding in highly crowded scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose $\textbf{GrabVG}$, a novel visual grounding framework inspired by human visual search. GrabVG explicitly decomposes grounding into two sequential stages: $\textit{preattentive hypothesis search}$ and $\textit{graph-attentive feature binding}$. Specifically, we first generate a compact set of reliable object hypotheses through distillation-guided proposal induction and text-aware hypothesis filtering, substantially reducing background distractions and semantic mismatches. These hypotheses are then organized into a sparse graph, where language-guided intra-instance visual cues and inter-instance topological relationships are jointly bound and propagated via graph attention, enabling efficient spatial reasoning and accurate target localization. Extensive experiments on AerialVG and AerialSense show that GrabVG achieves a favorable accuracy--speed trade-off, reaching 67.31$\%$ and 80.34$\%$ Acc@0.5 and outperforming the corresponding baselines by 10.55 and 8.76 percentage points, respectively.

摘要：視覺定位在無人機（UAV）影像中旨在根據自然語言描述在複雜的鳥瞰場景中定位目標物體。然而，小型、密集分佈且視覺上相似的物體的豐富性造成了高視覺冗餘，而重複的局部配置則產生了強烈的拓撲歧義。現有的方法主要集中在視覺-語言特徵對齊或密集上下文互動上，但它們在區分微妙的實例間差異和有效利用空間拓撲結構方面面臨挑戰，導致在高度擁擠的場景中定位不準確。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了$\textbf{GrabVG}$，這是一個受人類視覺搜索啟發的新型視覺定位框架。GrabVG明確地將定位分解為兩個連續階段：$\textit{前注意假設搜索}$和$\textit{圖注意特徵綁定}$。具體而言，我們首先通過蒸餾引導的提案誘導和文本感知的假設過濾生成一組緊湊的可靠物體假設，顯著減少背景干擾和語義不匹配。這些假設然後被組織成一個稀疏圖，其中語言引導的實例內視覺線索和實例間拓撲關係通過圖注意共同綁定和傳播，實現高效的空間推理和準確的目標定位。在AerialVG和AerialSense上的廣泛實驗表明，GrabVG實現了良好的準確性-速度權衡，達到67.31$\%$和80.34$\%$ Acc@0.5，並分別超過相應基準10.55和8.76個百分點。

docs.title: DeepWeaver: Bridging the Evidence Synthesis Gap in Open-Ended Question Answering
docs.text:
2608.18988v1 by Xujia Wang, Yizhe Zhang, Bin Xu, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li

Retrieve-then-generate pipelines are commonly used to produce deep-research answers for open-ended questions, but retrieval alone is insufficient: LLMs must organize noisy and fragmented evidence into comprehensive, well-cited answers. We refer to this process as evidence synthesis. However, direct generation often underuses evidence, misaligns citations, and collapses diverse information into shallow summaries, exposing an evidence synthesis gap between retrieval and generation. Thus, we propose DeepWeaver, a novel framework that weaves noisy retrieved evidence into comprehensive answers by maintaining Thought Block Chains (TBCs), a structured representation that groups claims, salient information, keywords, and supporting evidence. DeepWeaver uses subordinate TBCs to inspect residual evidence, commit TBC revisions, and discover new claims before final generation. We evaluate DeepWeaver on open-ended QA over both knowledge bases and the web, and introduce LoQA, a high-density benchmark for evidence synthesis. Across multiple LLMs, DeepWeaver improves content sufficiency, citation grounding, and detail preservation on LoQA, while achieving deeper insights and higher citation quality on DeepResearch Bench. These results show that evidence weaving is an effective mechanism for bridging retrieval and generation in open-ended QA. Our code is available at https://github.com/KlozeWang/DeepWeaver.

摘要：檢索-然後生成的管道通常用於為開放式問題生成深入研究的答案，但僅僅依賴檢索是不夠的：大型語言模型必須將嘈雜和片段化的證據組織成全面且引用良好的答案。我們將此過程稱為證據綜合。然而，直接生成往往未充分利用證據，引用不對齊，並將多樣的信息壓縮成淺顯的摘要，暴露了檢索與生成之間的證據綜合差距。因此，我們提出了DeepWeaver，一個新穎的框架，通過維護思維區塊鏈（TBCs）將嘈雜的檢索證據編織成全面的答案，TBCs是一種結構化表示，將主張、顯著信息、關鍵詞和支持證據分組。DeepWeaver使用從屬TBCs來檢查剩餘證據、提交TBC修訂並在最終生成之前發現新主張。我們在知識庫和網絡上的開放式問答中評估DeepWeaver，並引入LoQA，一個高密度的證據綜合基準。在多個大型語言模型上，DeepWeaver提高了LoQA上的內容充分性、引用基礎和細節保留，同時在DeepResearch Bench上實現了更深的見解和更高的引用質量。這些結果表明，證據編織是一種有效的機制，用於彌合開放式問答中的檢索和生成。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/KlozeWang/DeepWeaver 獲得。

docs.title: SkillForge: Self-Distilling Agents for Project-Specific Issue Resolution
docs.text:
2608.18933v1 by Silin Chen, Han Li, Xiaodong Gu, Yuling Shi, Haibing Guan

Large language model (LLM) based agents have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in automated software issue resolution, yet they often struggle to resolve issues in a specific repository because they lack project-specific knowledge. Existing self-evolving approaches acquire such knowledge from repository history or online repair trajectories, but they either depend on available historical issue-resolution signals or incur substantial per-issue test-time exploration cost. In this paper, we propose SkillForge, a self-distillation framework that proactively acquires project-specific knowledge from the repository itself. Instead of waiting for real issues to expose project-specific knowledge gaps, SkillForge synthesizes project-specific issues by re-implementing test-covered core functionalities of the repository. By resolving these synthetic issues, SkillForge distills reusable project-specific knowledge into entity-grounded skills and associates them with relevant repository entities for future issue resolution. Extensive experiments using both open-source and closed-source models show that SkillForge consistently improves issue resolution performance over strong baselines. These results demonstrate that proactively acquiring project-specific knowledge before solving real issues substantially improves downstream software issue resolution.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLM）基礎的代理在自動化軟體問題解決方面展現了卓越的能力，然而它們在特定儲存庫中解決問題時常常遇到困難，因為它們缺乏專案特定的知識。現有的自我演化方法從儲存庫歷史或線上修復軌跡中獲取這些知識，但它們要麼依賴可用的歷史問題解決信號，要麼在每個問題的測試時間探索上產生可觀的成本。在本文中，我們提出了SkillForge，一個自我蒸餾框架，主動從儲存庫本身獲取專案特定的知識。SkillForge通過重新實現儲存庫的測試覆蓋核心功能來合成專案特定的問題，而不是等待真實問題暴露專案特定的知識空白。通過解決這些合成問題，SkillForge將可重用的專案特定知識蒸餾為實體基礎的技能，並將其與相關的儲存庫實體關聯，以便未來的問題解決。使用開源和閉源模型的廣泛實驗顯示，SkillForge在強基準上持續改善問題解決性能。這些結果表明，在解決真實問題之前主動獲取專案特定知識顯著改善了下游的軟體問題解決。

docs.title: Syntactic Simplification of OWL Class Expressions
docs.text:
2608.18899v1 by Alkid Baci, N'Dah Jean Kouagou, Caglar Demir, Axel-Cyrille Ngonga Ngomo

Class expression learning often produces complex OWL class expressions that are difficult to interpret and reason over. However, by following theoretically grounded simplification principles, this complexity can be reduced. In this paper, we propose Class Expression Simplifier (CES), a novel algorithm for the syntactic simplification of class expressions in Description Logics (DL). CES aims to preserve formal semantics while reducing representational complexity. It systematically applies rewriting rules to eliminate redundancies and identify simpler yet equivalent expressions, thereby producing more compact and human-readable representations without altering logical entailments. We evaluate the effectiveness of CES on class expressions learned from two medium-sized ontologies, demonstrating measurable improvements in reasoning efficiency and reductions in verbosity. This work contributes to the broader goal of making ontology-driven applications more accessible, maintainable, and scalable, with direct implications for knowledge graph construction, semantic search, and Web-scale reasoning. CES is implemented within the open-source Python framework OWLAPY and is publicly available.

摘要：類別表達學習經常產生複雜的OWL類別表達式，這些表達式難以解釋和推理。然而，通過遵循理論基礎的簡化原則，可以減少這種複雜性。在本文中，我們提出了類別表達式簡化器（Class Expression Simplifier, CES），這是一種用於描述邏輯（Description Logics, DL）中類別表達式的語法簡化的新算法。CES旨在在減少表達複雜性的同時保持正式語義。它系統地應用重寫規則來消除冗餘，並識別更簡單但等價的表達式，從而生成更緊湊且易於人類閱讀的表示，而不改變邏輯推導。我們在從兩個中型本體學習的類別表達式上評估CES的有效性，顯示出推理效率的可測量改善和冗長性的減少。這項工作有助於實現使基於本體的應用程序更易於訪問、維護和擴展的更廣泛目標，對知識圖譜構建、語義搜索和網絡規模推理具有直接影響。CES已在開源Python框架OWLAPY中實現，並公開可用。

docs.title: DentAgent: Evidence-Centric Multi-Agent Coordination for Multimodal Dental Reasoning
docs.text:
2608.18878v1 by Zijie Meng, Xiwei Dai, Yixuan Tang, Jin Hao, Yang Feng, Fudong Zhu, Xiaoqiang Liu, Shaosheng Cao, Zuozhu Liu

Oral diseases affect billions of people worldwide, underscoring a pressing need for accurate and reliable dental assessment that integrates heterogeneous evidence from domain knowledge, radiographs, intraoral photographs, and 3D dental data. Most existing dental AI systems remain modality- or task-specific. Although recent vision-language models support flexible dental question answering, directly generated response leaves evidence implicit and untraceable. To address these limitations, we introduce DentAgent, an evidence-centric multi-agent framework, in which the Orchestrator coordinate five specialized agents spanning various modalities. Each specialist utilizes domain tools to convert observations into structured evidence records. The Evidence Blackboard manages these records as a shared evidence state, tracking coverage, gaps, and conflicts before response generation. This standardized evidence representation integrates isolated dental capabilities into a unified agentic workflow. Across four benchmarks, DentAgent demonstrates leading performance, even surpassing the senior specialists by 17.3 percentage points on multi-label diagnosis, which supports its value for broadly applicable and traceable multimodal dental reasoning, and highlights its potential as a technical foundation for population oral health assessment and management.

摘要：口腔疾病影響全球數十億人，凸顯出對準確且可靠的牙科評估的迫切需求，該評估整合了來自領域知識、放射影像、口腔內部照片和3D牙科數據的異質證據。大多數現有的牙科人工智慧系統仍然是特定於模態或任務的。儘管最近的視覺-語言模型支持靈活的牙科問題回答，但直接生成的回應使得證據隱含且無法追溯。為了解決這些限制，我們引入了DentAgent，一個以證據為中心的多代理框架，其中協調者協調五個專門的代理，涵蓋各種模態。每個專家利用領域工具將觀察轉換為結構化的證據記錄。證據黑板管理這些記錄作為共享的證據狀態，在生成回應之前跟踪覆蓋範圍、空白和衝突。這種標準化的證據表示將孤立的牙科能力整合到統一的代理工作流程中。在四個基準測試中，DentAgent顯示出領先的性能，甚至在多標籤診斷上超過了資深專家17.3個百分點，這支持了其在廣泛適用和可追溯的多模態牙科推理中的價值，並突顯了其作為人口口腔健康評估和管理的技術基礎的潛力。

docs.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents
docs.text:
2608.18852v1 by Qingyao Li, Wenxiang Jiao, Shuai Shao, Kangning Zhang, Yuan Lu, Yi Guo, Weiwen Liu, Weinan Zhang, Yong Yu

Agent frameworks increasingly package procedural knowledge as skills: instruction files an agent reads on demand, while public libraries now hold thousands of them. Which skill to read has thus become a decision the policy itself makes in the middle of an episode, yet no existing signal trains it. We show that the default remedy, outcome-rewarded RL over the candidate slate, cannot teach it, for a structural reason we identify and name selector credit starvation: under a broadcast, sequence-level advantage, the few tokens that name the chosen skill carry a vanishing share of the loss, and the credit they inherit is increasingly wrong-signed as trajectories lengthen. A correct choice is punished whenever the execution after it fails, even though the choice itself is among the most valuable decisions in the trajectory. Auditing a completed run's own training artifacts confirms all three properties, each worsening monotonically with horizon. SkillGate removes the failure by construction: it partitions the token support into two disjoint credit channels, outcome credit reaching only execution tokens, and a separate action-local advantage reaching exactly the skill-naming tokens, positive only when a trajectory's single read is the correct one. On five agentic benchmarks under a 16-candidate slate, SkillGate lifts a 9B policy from 40.8% to 53.2% trial success, well ahead of the identical budget spent on outcome reward alone, while cutting exposure to misleading candidates by two thirds and reading fewer skills.

摘要：代理框架越來越多地將程序知識包裝為技能：代理根據需求閱讀的指令檔案，而公共庫現在擁有數千個這樣的檔案。因此，選擇閱讀哪項技能已成為政策在一個情節中所做的決策，但目前沒有現有的信號來訓練它。我們顯示，默認的補救措施，即在候選清單上進行結果獎勵的強化學習，無法教會它，因為我們識別並命名的結構性原因是選擇者信貸饑餓：在廣播的序列級優勢下，命名所選技能的少數標記承擔著逐漸消失的損失份額，而隨著軌跡的延長，它們所繼承的信貸越來越多地是錯誤的。每當其後的執行失敗時，正確的選擇就會受到懲罰，即使這個選擇本身在軌跡中是最有價值的決策之一。對已完成運行的訓練文物進行審核確認了所有三個屬性，並且每個屬性隨著時間的推移而單調惡化。SkillGate 通過構造消除了失敗：它將標記支持劃分為兩個不相交的信貸通道，結果信貸僅達到執行標記，而一個單獨的行動本地優勢則恰好達到命名技能的標記，僅在軌跡的單次閱讀是正確的時候為正。在五個代理基準下，SkillGate 將一個 90 億的政策從 40.8% 提升到 53.2% 的試驗成功率，遠遠超過僅在結果獎勵上花費的相同預算，同時將對誤導性候選者的曝光減少三分之二，並閱讀更少的技能。

docs.title: Identifying Implicit Premises for Logical Reconstruction of Argument Graphs
docs.text:
2608.18821v1 by Xuyao Feng, Anthony Hunter

The logical reconstruction of argument graphs from natural language text is challenging because of the prevalence of enthymemes (i.e., arguments with implicit premises). There are natural language processing methods for identifying enthymemes in text, and there are symbolic methods based on abduction for identifying missing premises in a logical representation of enthymemes. However, there is a need for methods to generate implicit premises to logically show a known entailment or contradiction relationship between a pair of statements. To address this, we propose a neuro-symbolic pipeline that uses large language models (LLMs) to generate intermediate implicit premises that are translated into logical formulae and used with logical formulae representing explicit premises and explicit claims to show the logical relationships between them (entailment, contradiction, or neutrality). Our approach is evaluated on the Microtext Argumentative Corpus.

摘要：從自然語言文本中邏輯重建論證圖是具有挑戰性的，因為隱含前提（即具有隱含前提的論證）的普遍存在。有自然語言處理方法可以識別文本中的隱含前提，還有基於推理的符號方法用於識別隱含前提的邏輯表示中的缺失前提。然而，需要方法來生成隱含前提，以邏輯上顯示一對陳述之間已知的包含或矛盾關係。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個神經符號管道，利用大型語言模型（LLMs）生成中間隱含前提，這些隱含前提被轉換為邏輯公式，並與表示明確前提和明確主張的邏輯公式一起使用，以顯示它們之間的邏輯關係（包含、矛盾或中立）。我們的方法在微文本論證語料庫上進行了評估。

docs.title: Pairwise Logical Selection of Enthymeme Completions under Semantic-Link Uncertainty
docs.text:
2608.18820v1 by Xuyao Feng, Antonis Bikakis

Arguments often omit premises or claims, forming enthymemes. We study pairwise logical selection between two candidates for the omitted component. Existing natural language methods can identify or generate candidates but often do not expose how the selected candidate completes the inference, while logic-based approaches usually assume that the required formulae and background knowledge are available. We extend a prior neuro-symbolic pipeline from missing-premise to missing-claim selection and replace binary entailment outcomes with logical-resistance scores. Top-Link uses weighted Partial MaxSAT under a single configuration of highest-confidence semantic links. We then introduce Possible-World Atom-Link Formalization (PWAL), which keeps translated formulae fixed and marginalizes logical resistance over alternative cross-formula semantic-link configurations. We evaluate PWAL on five tasks: ARCT and a CDED-derived task for missing-premise selection, iDebate- and AAE2-derived tasks for missing-claim selection, and alphaNLI for abductive hypothesis selection. Relative to Top-Link, PWAL raises strict accuracy by 2.95-30.86 percentage points and reduces tie rates by 4.57-58.00 percentage points on all five tasks. When ties receive half credit, accuracy still increases by 0.45-6.04 percentage points. PWAL also records the translated formulae, sampled link configurations, and resistance components for every comparison, providing a transparent trace of each score.

摘要：論證經常省略前提或主張，形成隱含命題。我們研究兩個候選者之間的成對邏輯選擇，以填補省略的組件。現有的自然語言方法可以識別或生成候選者，但通常不會揭示所選候選者如何完成推理，而基於邏輯的方法通常假設所需的公式和背景知識是可用的。我們將先前的神經符號管道從缺失前提擴展到缺失主張的選擇，並用邏輯抵抗分數替換二元蕴涵結果。Top-Link 在單一配置的最高置信度語義鏈下使用加權的部分最大滿足問題（Partial MaxSAT）。然後，我們引入可能世界原子鏈接形式化（PWAL），該形式化保持翻譯公式不變，並對替代的跨公式語義鏈配置進行邏輯抵抗的邊際化。我們在五個任務上評估 PWAL：ARCT 和一個基於 CDED 的缺失前提選擇任務，iDebate 和 AAE2 衍生的缺失主張選擇任務，以及 alphaNLI 用於推論假設選擇。相對於 Top-Link，PWAL 在所有五個任務上將嚴格準確率提高了 2.95-30.86 個百分點，並將平局率降低了 4.57-58.00 個百分點。當平局獲得半分時，準確率仍然增加了 0.45-6.04 個百分點。PWAL 還記錄了翻譯公式、抽樣鏈接配置和每次比較的抵抗組件，提供了每個分數的透明追蹤。

docs.title: Forgetting, plasticity, and co-observation: a third facet of continual learning
docs.text:
2608.18803v1 by Timm Hess, Abhishek Jha, Gido M. van de Ven, Tinne Tuytelaars

Efficient continual learning remains a fundamental challenge for deep neural networks. While catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity are widely considered the primary obstacles to overcome, we show that these two issues cannot fully explain the performance gap between naive sequential training and offline joint training. In this paper, we highlight data co-observation as a distinct factor influencing continual learning performance. By decoupling the constraints of separate data access from stability and plasticity, we systematically investigate the representational benefits gained by observing training data together. Empirically, we demonstrate a consistent performance difference between joint and separate training across both supervised and self-supervised paradigms in generic data-incremental "chunking" scenarios, whilst mitigating forgetting and controlling for plasticity. Our findings indicate that simultaneous observation of training data (co-observation) yields benefits to the learner's generalization that extend well beyond mere knowledge retention, and that this effect does not require a specific continual distribution shift. Furthermore, we contextualize prominent continual learning mechanisms through this lens: while distillation-based approaches act only as effective knowledge retention mechanisms, our results suggest that the empirical success of memory replay goes beyond the mitigation of forgetting, actively reintroducing the benefits of data co-observation into the learning process.

摘要：有效的持續學習仍然是深度神經網絡的一個基本挑戰。雖然災難性遺忘和可塑性的喪失被廣泛認為是需要克服的主要障礙，但我們表明這兩個問題無法完全解釋天真的序列訓練和離線聯合訓練之間的性能差距。在本文中，我們強調數據共同觀察作為影響持續學習性能的一個獨特因素。通過將單獨數據訪問的約束與穩定性和可塑性解耦，我們系統地研究了通過共同觀察訓練數據所獲得的表徵利益。實證上，我們展示了在通用數據增量“分塊”場景中，聯合訓練和單獨訓練之間在監督和自監督範式下的一致性能差異，同時減輕遺忘並控制可塑性。我們的研究結果表明，同時觀察訓練數據（共同觀察）為學習者的泛化帶來的好處遠超過單純的知識保留，並且這一效果不需要特定的持續分佈轉變。此外，我們通過這一視角將突出的持續學習機制進行了背景化：雖然基於蒸餾的方法僅作為有效的知識保留機制，但我們的結果表明，記憶重放的實證成功超越了遺忘的減輕，積極地將數據共同觀察的好處重新引入學習過程中。

docs.title: Epistemic Subordination: Generative AI and the Infrastructure of Knowledge
docs.text:
2608.18758v1 by Gilad Abiri, Emanuel V. Towfigh

Generative AI does not merely produce biased outputs. It encodes the majority's way of knowing as the default infrastructure of knowledge itself. We call this epistemic subordination. The training process compresses the full breadth of human expression into a single probabilistic model whose statistical baseline reflects the languages, assumptions, and cultural frameworks of the dominant culture. Minority epistemologies are not excluded but absorbed: present in the training data, yet structurally subordinated in the output. The result is not a collection of discrete biases that can be audited and corrected. It is an epistemic condition embedded in the architecture from which all outputs emerge. This unified harm cuts across three legal domains -- anti-discrimination law, cultural and linguistic rights, and democratic viewpoint pluralism -- and each fails to address it for the same structural reason: existing law regulates downstream, at the level of decisions and applications. The remedy must match the site of harm. If epistemic subordination is produced at the level of model training, then law must learn to govern at that level.

摘要：生成式人工智慧不僅僅產生偏見的輸出。它將大多數人的認知方式編碼為知識本身的默認基礎設施。我們稱之為認識上的從屬。訓練過程將人類表達的全部範疇壓縮成一個單一的概率模型，其統計基線反映了主導文化的語言、假設和文化框架。少數群體的認識論並不是被排除，而是被吸收：它們存在於訓練數據中，但在輸出中結構性地處於從屬地位。結果並不是一組可以審核和修正的離散偏見。這是一種嵌入所有輸出產生架構中的認識狀態。這種統一的傷害橫跨三個法律領域——反歧視法、文化和語言權利，以及民主觀點多元主義——而每一個領域都因為相同的結構性原因未能解決這個問題：現有法律在決策和應用層面進行調節。補救措施必須與傷害的發生地點相匹配。如果認識上的從屬是在模型訓練層面產生的，那麼法律必須學會在該層面進行治理。

docs.title: Execution-grounded evaluation reveals hidden failures in language-model calculations for environmental science
docs.text:
2608.18726v1 by Maohao Ran, Chendong Ma, Yanting Zhang, Dailing Jiang, Yusen Huang, Meng Gao, Jun Song

Large language models are increasingly used for quantitative work in the environmental sciences, yet existing evaluations score only final answers, leaving calculation process unobserved. Here we introduce AtmosCoder-Bench, an execution-grounded benchmark that makes the calculation process visible. Built through a transferable semi-automated pipeline (436 problems, 3,910 variants, 7,029 graded quantities), every problem is validated to be unambiguous and human-solvable, with uniquely verifiable answers. We find that (i) multiple-choice formats inflate measured accuracy by at least 12 percentage points; (ii) many failures arise not from missing knowledge but from models failing to apply known formulas and constraints consistently throughout multi-step computation; and (iii) even frontier models remain weak when task-specific conditions invalidate familiar methods, often reverting to canonical solution patterns rather than adapting methods to the relevant physical regime, leaving expert oversight essential.

摘要：大型語言模型在環境科學的定量工作中越來越被使用，然而現有的評估僅評分最終答案，計算過程卻未被觀察到。這裡我們介紹 AtmosCoder-Bench，一個基於執行的基準，使計算過程可見。通過一個可轉移的半自動化流程（436 個問題，3,910 個變體，7,029 個評分數量）構建，每個問題都經過驗證，確保其明確且可由人類解決，並擁有獨特可驗證的答案。我們發現 (i) 多選格式使測量的準確性至少提高了 12 個百分點；(ii) 許多失敗並非因為缺乏知識，而是因為模型未能在多步計算中始終如一地應用已知的公式和約束；以及 (iii) 即使是前沿模型在任務特定條件使熟悉的方法失效時仍然表現不佳，往往回歸到經典的解決模式，而不是將方法適應於相關的物理範疇，這使得專家的監督變得至關重要。

docs.title: Change Point--Aware Evaluation and Re-Calibration of PPG-Based Blood Pressure Estimation
docs.text:
2608.18639v1 by Yunwon Tae, Minje Park, Gyunho Rho, Dongjoon Yoo, Sunghoon Joo

Non-invasive continuous blood pressure (BP) monitoring using photoplethysmography (PPG) is a promising alternative to cuff-based measurements. However, existing PPG-based BP estimation studies predominantly rely on aggregated performance metrics (e.g., mean absolute error) computed over entire evaluation intervals, which can obscure model failures during rapid BP fluctuations and limit clinical relevance. In this work, we propose a fluctuation-aware evaluation framework for PPG-based BP estimation based on time-series change point detection. Instead of heuristic BP thresholding (e.g., $Δ\mathrm{BP} > 10\mathrm{mmHg}$), we identify BP change points by capturing abrupt distributional shifts in BP trajectories and evaluate estimation performance specifically during these fluctuation periods. Our analysis shows that several state-of-the-art models exhibit substantial performance degradation around BP change points, and that periodic test-time calibration is insufficient to handle such dynamic BP variations. To address this limitation, we introduce a targeted re-calibration framework triggered by detected BP change points, improving robustness without modifying model architectures. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic evaluation of PPG-based BP estimation from a BP change point perspective, highlighting the importance of fluctuation-aware evaluation and calibration for real-world continuous BP monitoring.

摘要：非侵入式持續血壓 (BP) 監測使用光電容積描記法 (PPG) 是一種有前景的替代於袖帶式測量的方法。然而，現有的基於 PPG 的 BP 估計研究主要依賴於整體評估區間計算的聚合性能指標（例如，平均絕對誤差），這可能會掩蓋模型在快速 BP 波動期間的失敗，並限制臨床相關性。在本研究中，我們提出了一種基於時間序列變化點檢測的 PPG 基於 BP 估計的波動感知評估框架。我們通過捕捉 BP 軌跡中的突變分佈變化來識別 BP 變化點，而不是使用啟發式 BP 閾值（例如，$Δ\mathrm{BP} > 10\mathrm{mmHg}$），並專門在這些波動期間評估估計性能。我們的分析顯示，幾個最先進的模型在 BP 變化點附近表現出顯著的性能下降，並且定期的測試時間校準不足以應對這種動態 BP 變化。為了解決這一限制，我們引入了一種由檢測到的 BP 變化點觸發的針對性重新校準框架，在不修改模型架構的情況下提高了穩健性。據我們所知，這是首次從 BP 變化點的角度系統性評估基於 PPG 的 BP 估計，突顯了波動感知評估和校準在現實世界持續 BP 監測中的重要性。

docs.title: CTIFoundry: An Agent-Native Corpus Scaffold for Cyber Threat Intelligence
docs.text:
2608.18613v1 by Yutong Cheng, Changze Li, Qian Cui, Wei Ding, Lingzhi Wang, Yan Chen, Peng Gao

Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) is increasingly consumed not by human analysts but by LLM agents that compose multi-step investigations at query time. The harness side of this shift has matured rapidly (planning loops, tool protocols, context management), but the corpus side has not: threat reports and vulnerability databases are still packaged for retrieval-augmented generation, as opaque chunks behind an embedding index. We argue that this substrate, not model capability, is the bottleneck on agentic CTI investigation, and present CTIFoundry, an agent-native corpus scaffold. At build time, CTIFoundry materializes the latent structure of a CTI corpus: a deterministic ontology graph over four authoritative knowledge bases (CVE, CWE, CAPEC, ATT&CK) whose official cross-references become typed, traversable edges; a span-grounded report layer whose canonical, alias-resolved cross-vendor entities index provenance-carrying chunks; and hybrid dense+lexical retrieval surfaces. At query time this structure is exposed through seven typed tools and three procedural skills mounted on a stock open-source agent harness. On the public CTIConnect benchmark, swapping only the action surface lifts the identically-harnessed agent by +0.19 to +0.28 overall F1 across a four-model, two-provider panel: a small model on CTIFoundry surpasses a flagship on the flat substrate, and the gain is not bought with search effort, since on both Claude models the scaffolded agent is more accurate at roughly half the tool calls. An ablation attributes it: typed structure carries the larger share, procedural skills convert structure into discipline, and the two compose super-additively, because skills bind only to structure that exists.

摘要：網路威脅情報（CTI）越來越多地被大型語言模型（LLM）代理消耗，而不是人類分析師，這些代理在查詢時組成多步調查。這一轉變的利用面迅速成熟（計畫循環、工具協議、上下文管理），但其語料庫面卻未能跟上：威脅報告和漏洞數據庫仍然以檢索增強生成的形式包裝，作為嵌入索引後的不透明塊。我們認為，這一基礎結構，而非模型能力，是代理CTI調查的瓶頸，並提出CTIFoundry，一個代理原生的語料庫框架。在構建時，CTIFoundry實現了CTI語料庫的潛在結構：一個基於四個權威知識庫（CVE、CWE、CAPEC、ATT&CK）的確定性本體圖，其官方交叉引用成為類型化的、可遍歷的邊緣；一個基於跨度的報告層，其標準化、別名解析的跨供應商實體索引承載來源的塊；以及混合的密集+詞彙檢索表面。在查詢時，這一結構通過七個類型化工具和三個程序技能在一個標準的開源代理框架上暴露。在公共CTIConnect基準測試中，僅更換行動表面就使得同樣框架的代理整體F1提升了+0.19到+0.28，涵蓋四個模型、兩個提供者的面板：CTIFoundry上的小型模型超越了平面基礎上的旗艦模型，且這一增益並未以搜索努力為代價，因為在兩個Claude模型上，搭建的代理在大約一半的工具調用中更為準確。一項消融實驗將其歸因於：類型化結構承擔了更大的份額，程序技能將結構轉化為紀律，兩者超加性地組合，因為技能僅綁定於已存在的結構。

docs.title: OmniHandwritingOCR: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal LLMs in Handwritten OCR Scenarios
docs.text:
2608.18586v1 by Zinuo Guo, Min Zhang, Bo Jiang

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as OCR systems in document and knowledge-processing pipelines, but their ability to faithfully read real handwriting remains underexplored. Existing OCR benchmarks focus largely on printed text or clean single-line inputs, leaving limited coverage of realistic handwritten OCR scenarios such as multilingual handwriting, writer errors, and structurally complex mathematical expressions. We introduce OmniHandwritingOCR, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating MLLMs and OCR systems on handwritten OCR. It covers handwritten text recognition and handwritten mathematical expression recognition across six subtasks and twelve subsets, totaling 77.57K labeled images from public datasets and newly collected student writings. A key component is a difficulty-stratified multi-line formula corpus designed to test robustness under increasing structural complexity. We evaluate thirteen open- and closed-source systems with five complementary metrics under a unified protocol. Results show that current systems remain far from faithful transcription: performance drops sharply on complex multi-line formulas, model rankings vary across language and formula settings, and several generative models hallucinate plausible but visually unsupported corrections. OmniHandwritingOCR provides a challenging testbed for diagnosing language, content, structural, and visual-grounding failure modes of multimodal models in handwritten OCR scenarios.

摘要：多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在文檔和知識處理管道中越來越多地用作光學字符識別（OCR）系統，但它們忠實閱讀真實手寫文字的能力仍然未被充分探索。現有的OCR基準主要集中在印刷文本或乾淨的單行輸入上，對於現實手寫OCR場景的覆蓋範圍有限，例如多語言手寫、書寫者錯誤和結構複雜的數學表達式。我們介紹了OmniHandwritingOCR，一個用於評估MLLMs和OCR系統在手寫OCR方面的診斷基準。它涵蓋了手寫文本識別和手寫數學表達式識別，分為六個子任務和十二個子集，總計77.57K標記圖像來自公共數據集和新收集的學生寫作。其關鍵組件是一個難度分層的多行公式語料庫，旨在測試在結構複雜性增加下的穩健性。我們在統一協議下使用五個互補指標評估了十三個開源和閉源系統。結果顯示，當前系統距離忠實轉錄仍然相去甚遠：在複雜的多行公式上性能急劇下降，模型排名在不同語言和公式設置中變化，並且幾個生成模型會幻覺出看似合理但視覺上不支持的修正。OmniHandwritingOCR為診斷多模態模型在手寫OCR場景中的語言、內容、結構和視覺基礎失效模式提供了一個具有挑戰性的測試平台。

docs.title: From Storage to Access: Verifiable Activation of Parametric Knowledge in LLMs via Explicit Priming and Implicit Reasoning
docs.text:
2608.18581v1 by Zuocheng Ying, Yang Yang, Yumou Wu, Chuanbo Zhu, Jiarui Wang, Ziqi Wu, Jingming Cai, Junqing Yu, Zikai Song

Although Large Language Models (LLMs) encode rich factual knowledge in their parameters, reliably recalling and verifying such knowledge remains a key bottleneck in factual question answering. Existing end-to-end methods entangle knowledge elicitation with reasoning, making it difficult to determine whether correct answers arise from parametric knowledge or the input context. To address this challenge, we propose VAKE (Verifiable Activation of Parametric KnowledgE), a two-stage reinforcement-learning framework that externalizes latent parametric knowledge through explicit Priming and transfers the acquired elicitation capability to implicit Reasoning. Given a query and an insufficient retrieved subgraph, the Priming policy explicitly inserts bridging triples as verifiable evidence, with supervision provided by rewards derived from answers generated by a separate frozen model over the augmented subgraph. Building on the policy learned during Priming, the Reasoning stage trains the model to answer from the original input, testing whether the capability acquired through explicit knowledge elicitation transfers to implicit reasoning. Experiments across seven benchmarks and models from 3B to 14B show that VAKE consistently outperforms standard baselines, including when transferring directly from HotpotQA to OOD datasets. LLM-based evaluation further shows that over 80% of the inserted triples provide factual bridging knowledge not derivable from the retrieved context, while more than half elicit knowledge inaccessible through direct prompting. These results suggest that VAKE activates latent parametric knowledge rather than copying the input context or memorizing dataset-specific associations.

摘要：儘管大型語言模型（LLMs）在其參數中編碼了豐富的事實知識，但可靠地回憶和驗證這些知識仍然是事實問題回答中的一個主要瓶頸。現有的端到端方法將知識引出與推理糾纏在一起，這使得難以確定正確答案是來自參數知識還是輸入上下文。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了VAKE（可驗證的參數知識激活），這是一個兩階段的強化學習框架，通過明確的引導將潛在的參數知識外部化，並將獲得的引出能力轉移到隱式推理中。給定一個查詢和一個不足的檢索子圖，引導策略明確插入作為可驗證證據的橋接三元組，並由從增強子圖生成的答案所衍生的獎勵提供監督。基於在引導過程中學到的策略，推理階段訓練模型從原始輸入中回答，測試通過明確的知識引出獲得的能力是否能轉移到隱式推理。跨越七個基準和從3B到14B的模型的實驗顯示，VAKE始終超越標準基準，包括在從HotpotQA直接轉移到OOD數據集時。基於LLM的評估進一步顯示，超過80%的插入三元組提供了無法從檢索上下文推導的事實橋接知識，而超過一半的三元組引出了無法通過直接提示訪問的知識。這些結果表明，VAKE激活了潛在的參數知識，而不是複製輸入上下文或記憶數據集特定的關聯。

docs.title: Beyond LLM-Based Reasoning: Lightweight GNNs for Agent Failure Attribution
docs.text:
2608.18575v1 by Ting-Wei Li, Yuanchen Bei, Xiao Lin, Hanghang Tong

Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) often exhibit complex failure modes, which frequently cause agents to produce incorrect outcomes. This motivates the task of Agent Failure Attribution: given a failed multi-agent trajectory, identify the faulty agents and their corresponding error types. Existing approaches predominantly rely on LLMs to perform failure attribution, either through direct prompting, fine-tuning on synthetic data or complex agentic pipelines. While effective, these methods incur substantial computational overhead due to long-context processing, expensive post-training and handcrafted workflows. Moreover, empirical evidence shows that even state-of-the-art models achieve limited accuracy on existing benchmarks, suggesting that scaling model size alone is insufficient. In this work, we revisit this task and question the necessity of such expensive generative solutions. We introduce AFANet, a lightweight graph-based framework that models interaction trajectories through step-level semantic signals and agent-level relationships. We show that with significantly fewer parameters and near-zero inference cost, AFANet (i) matches or outperforms LLM-based baselines, including fine-tuned models on in-domain benchmarks, (ii) maintains robust performance across different GNN architectures and (iii) can be further improved with inexpensive test-time adaptation on the OOD benchmark. Our results suggest that effective agent failure attribution does not require heavy LLM reasoning and a lightweight, structured approach can achieve strong performance.

摘要：大型語言模型 (LLM) 基礎的多代理系統 (MAS) 通常會出現複雜的故障模式，這經常導致代理產生不正確的結果。這促使了代理故障歸因的任務：給定一個失敗的多代理軌跡，識別故障代理及其相應的錯誤類型。現有的方法主要依賴 LLM 來執行故障歸因，無論是通過直接提示、在合成數據上進行微調，還是複雜的代理管道。雖然這些方法有效，但由於長上下文處理、昂貴的後訓練和手工製作的工作流程，這些方法會產生相當大的計算開銷。此外，實證證據顯示，即使是最先進的模型在現有基準上也僅能達到有限的準確度，這表明僅僅擴大模型大小並不足夠。在這項工作中，我們重新審視這一任務，並質疑這些昂貴生成解決方案的必要性。我們引入了 AFANet，一種輕量級的基於圖的框架，通過步驟級的語義信號和代理級的關係來建模互動軌跡。我們表明，AFANet 在參數顯著減少和近乎零的推理成本下，(i) 與基於 LLM 的基準相匹配或超越，包括在領域內基準上微調的模型，(ii) 在不同的 GNN 架構中保持穩健的性能，並且 (iii) 可以通過在 OOD 基準上進行低成本的測試時間適應進一步改進。我們的結果表明，有效的代理故障歸因並不需要繁重的 LLM 推理，輕量級的結構化方法可以實現強大的性能。

docs.title: Bridging Search and CRM: Productionizing AI Product Research Agents for Customer Re-Engagement
docs.text:
2608.18543v1 by Mandar Kulkarni, Pooja A., Samir Shah

Modern e-commerce platforms often operate search, recommendation, personalization, and CRM systems independently, limiting opportunities for proactive customer re-engagement. This is particularly challenging for exploratory intents such as best smartphones or latest 5G phones, where users may leave the platform for external research before purchasing. We present a scalable, production-deployed framework that bridges search and CRM workflows through AI-powered Product Research Agents. The system identifies users with exploratory purchase intent and low engagement, conducts grounded multi-agent product research using behavioral signals, external knowledge, and enterprise catalog data, and delivers personalized recommendations through WhatsApp. We evaluate the framework in a 23-day production deployment involving approximately 15K WhatsApp notifications for mobile product discovery. The campaign achieved substantial CTR improvements over traditional WhatsApp recommendation campaigns, with evidence of secondary engagement through message forwarding and sharing. The deployment also generated downstream purchases and GMV impact, demonstrating the practical effectiveness of AI Product Research Agents for proactive customer re-engagement and end-to-end customer journey optimization.

摘要：現代電子商務平台通常獨立運作搜索、推薦、個性化和客戶關係管理（CRM）系統，限制了主動客戶重新參與的機會。這對於探索性意圖（例如最佳智能手機或最新5G手機）尤其具有挑戰性，因為用戶可能在購買前會離開平台進行外部研究。我們提出了一個可擴展的、已投入生產的框架，通過人工智慧驅動的產品研究代理橋接搜索和CRM工作流程。該系統識別出具有探索性購買意圖和低參與度的用戶，利用行為信號、外部知識和企業目錄數據進行基於多代理的產品研究，並通過WhatsApp提供個性化推薦。我們在為期23天的生產部署中評估了該框架，涉及約15K條WhatsApp通知以促進移動產品發現。該活動在傳統WhatsApp推薦活動中實現了顯著的點擊率提升，並有證據顯示通過消息轉發和分享產生了二次參與。該部署還產生了下游購買和GMV影響，證明了人工智慧產品研究代理在主動客戶重新參與和端到端客戶旅程優化中的實際有效性。

docs.title: FinRCA-Bench: Benchmarking Evidence Retrieval and Reasoning for Financial AI Systems
docs.text:
2608.18534v1 by Pratik Ghawate

Large language models are increasingly used to support financial operations, but their apparent reasoning performance can depend on whether they receive the right evidence. In financial reconciliation, the evidence needed for diagnosis is distributed across invoices, purchase orders, approvals, allocations, payments, ledger entries, and bank activity, linked by transactional relationships rather than textual similarity. End-to-end accuracy can therefore conflate evidence access with reasoning quality. We introduce FinRCA-Bench, a deterministic synthetic benchmark of 2,250 accounts-payable-to-bank reconciliation cases spanning 14 operational tables, including 1,500 injected failures across 15 causal categories and 750 legitimate or hard-negative cases. Root-cause labels and record-level evidence contracts are hidden from the model, allowing retrieval to be evaluated independently of answer correctness. We compare Rules/SQL, classical machine learning, dense semantic retrieval, deterministic relational expansion, and Typed Provenance Graph Retrieval (TPGR), a typed traversal restricted to persisted transaction relationships. Rules/SQL reaches 84.97% held-out exact accuracy and classical ML reaches 95.44%. Holding the reasoning model, prompt, and generation settings fixed while changing only retrieval increases macro required-record recall from 0.83% to 77.70% and exact 16-class accuracy from 2.05% to 72.44%. Structural retrieval failures outnumber reasoning failures with sufficient retrieval by 95 to 15; 254 correct predictions occur despite incomplete retrieval, and strict returned-evidence contract accuracy is only 5.72%. On FinRCA-Bench, retrieval architecture strongly shapes observed AI-system performance, and a correct root-cause label is a weak proxy for an auditable diagnosis.

摘要：大型語言模型越來越多地被用來支持金融操作，但它們的推理表現顯然取決於是否獲得正確的證據。在財務對賬中，診斷所需的證據分佈在發票、採購訂單、批准、分配、付款、帳本條目和銀行活動中，這些證據通過交易關係而非文本相似性相連。因此，端到端的準確性可能會將證據訪問與推理質量混淆。我們介紹了FinRCA-Bench，這是一個確定性的合成基準，包括2,250個應付帳款到銀行的對賬案例，涵蓋14個操作表，包括15個因果類別中的1,500個注入失敗和750個合法或困難的負面案例。根本原因標籤和記錄級證據合約對模型是隱藏的，這樣可以獨立評估檢索，而不受答案正確性的影響。我們比較了規則/SQL、經典機器學習、密集語義檢索、確定性關係擴展和類型化來源圖檢索（TPGR），這是一種限制於持久交易關係的類型遍歷。規則/SQL達到84.97%的保留精確度，而經典機器學習達到95.44%。在固定推理模型、提示和生成設置的同時僅改變檢索，宏觀所需記錄的召回率從0.83%提高到77.70%，而16類的精確度從2.05%提高到72.44%。在充分檢索的情況下，結構檢索失敗的次數以95比15超過推理失敗；儘管檢索不完整，仍然出現254個正確預測，且嚴格的返回證據合約準確率僅為5.72%。在FinRCA-Bench上，檢索架構強烈影響觀察到的AI系統性能，正確的根本原因標籤對可審計診斷來說是一個弱代理。

docs.title: DART-SD: Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
docs.text:
2608.18524v1 by Hangrui Xu, Jiarui Wang, Yang Yang, Chuanbo Zhu, Fangda Chen, Ziqi Wu, Jingming Cai, Yan Song

Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with multi-turn tool-calling capabilities is essential for building autonomous agents. However, progress is fundamentally limited by the reliance on full-length trajectory imitation. For tasks involving multiple order-independent sub-goals, the optimal solution space forms a vast combinatorial diamond lattice. Forcing this rich topology into monolithic trajectories causes a severe topological collapse, indiscriminately penalizing valid alternative explorations and severely degrading policy diversity. To address this, we propose DART-SD (Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation), a novel framework that shifts the paradigm from global forcing to topology-guided localized correction. DART-SD first models the execution process as a converging Interaction-State Transition Graph (ISTG), faithfully capturing the inherent diamond topology of successful and failed exploratory paths. During autonomous rollouts, the framework identifies the Critical Topological Breakpoint (CTB) and retrieves success-supported recovery references. Finally, we introduce a progressive self-distillation paradigm through CTB-guided localized supervision, ensuring that the training loss is calculated exclusively on the generated recovery steps while strictly protecting the valid reasoning prefix from destructive gradient updates. Experiments on complex multi-turn tool-calling benchmarks demonstrate that DART-SD significantly outperforms traditional full-trajectory baselines.

摘要：為大型語言模型（LLMs）配備多輪工具調用能力對於建立自主代理至關重要。然而，進展在根本上受到對完整軌跡模仿的依賴所限制。對於涉及多個無序子目標的任務，最佳解空間形成一個龐大的組合鑽石晶格。將這種豐富的拓撲強制進入單一的軌跡會導致嚴重的拓撲崩潰，無差別地懲罰有效的替代探索，並嚴重降低政策多樣性。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了DART-SD（鑽石拓撲感知檢索與自我蒸餾調整），這是一個新穎的框架，將範式從全局強制轉變為拓撲引導的局部修正。DART-SD首先將執行過程建模為一個收斂的互動狀態轉換圖（ISTG），忠實地捕捉成功和失敗探索路徑的內在鑽石拓撲。在自主展開過程中，該框架識別關鍵拓撲斷點（CTB）並檢索成功支持的恢復參考。最後，我們通過CTB引導的局部監督引入了一個漸進的自我蒸餾範式，確保訓練損失僅在生成的恢復步驟上計算，同時嚴格保護有效推理前綴不受破壞性梯度更新的影響。在複雜的多輪工具調用基準測試中，實驗表明DART-SD顯著超越了傳統的全軌跡基準。

docs.title: MissDiag: Diagnostic Evaluation of Incomplete-Knowledge Robustness in KGQA and KG-RAG
docs.text:
2608.18489v1 by Hang Wang, Hang Dong, Lu Liu, Chuanru Ren

Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) and knowledge-graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (KG-RAG) aim to ground answers in explicit graph evidence, but real-world knowledge graphs are often sparse, outdated, and incomplete. Existing robustness evaluations usually report aggregate changes in answer quality after evidence is removed or perturbed, which measures sensitivity to incomplete support but leaves the source of degradation under-specified: the same score change can conflate the type of missing evidence, the response of the evaluated system, and the sensitivity of the answer-matching protocol. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{MissDiag}, a diagnostic evaluation framework for incomplete-knowledge robustness in KGQA and KG-RAG. MissDiag keeps the question and gold answer fixed while applying structurally typed missingness interventions to benchmark-provided support graphs, enabling paired comparisons that decompose robustness changes by evidence type, system response, and evaluation protocol rather than reducing them to a single aggregate score drop. Experiments across multiple system families show that incomplete-knowledge robustness is better understood as a typed degradation phenomenon than as a uniform property: answer-adjacent evidence loss produces the largest observed degradation, source-context removal is often neutral and can be beneficial, and semantic answer matching changes absolute scores while preserving the main typed degradation patterns. By transforming aggregate robustness measurement into typed diagnostic attribution, MissDiag provides a more interpretable basis for comparing, diagnosing, and stress-testing KGQA and KG-RAG systems under incomplete knowledge.

摘要：知識圖譜問答（KGQA）和基於知識圖譜的檢索增強生成（KG-RAG）旨在將答案基於明確的圖形證據，但現實世界中的知識圖譜往往是稀疏的、過時的和不完整的。現有的穩健性評估通常報告在證據被移除或擾動後答案質量的整體變化，這測量了對不完整支持的敏感性，但未明確指出退化的來源：相同的分數變化可能混淆缺失證據的類型、被評估系統的反應以及答案匹配協議的敏感性。為了解決這一問題，我們提出了\textbf{MissDiag}，一個用於KGQA和KG-RAG中不完整知識穩健性的診斷評估框架。MissDiag在應用結構性類型缺失干預到基準提供的支持圖時，保持問題和正確答案不變，從而實現配對比較，通過證據類型、系統反應和評估協議來分解穩健性變化，而不是將其簡化為單一的整體分數下降。在多個系統系列的實驗中顯示，不完整知識的穩健性更應被理解為一種類型退化現象，而不是一種均勻特性：答案相鄰的證據損失產生了觀察到的最大退化，來源上下文的移除通常是中性的，並且可能是有益的，而語義答案匹配改變了絕對分數，同時保留了主要的類型退化模式。通過將整體穩健性測量轉化為類型診斷歸因，MissDiag為在不完整知識下比較、診斷和壓力測試KGQA和KG-RAG系統提供了更具可解釋性的基礎。

docs.title: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents
docs.text:
2608.18423v1 by Tianyou Wang, Chongyang Gao, Kezhen Chen, Chen Dong, Yinghao He, Donghan Li, Wangcheng Xu, Hongjiu Zhang, Chi Li

Language model agents now execute bounded tasks reliably. Whether they can sustain effective decision-making over long horizons, where actions have cumulative consequences and the environment responds to their choices, remains largely unmeasured. FM-Bench (Football Management Benchmark) measures this. An LLM agent runs a football club for 20 in-game years through 26 tools and roughly 340 to 400 decision stops. It drafts a squad on the same budget as every rival, trades players, negotiates contracts, invests in facilities and youth, sets lineups, and answers to a board that can fire it, while a deterministic engine accumulates every year into one final score with no LLM judge or human rater. The solo track plays each of 15 frontier models against a frozen scripted world, and the Arena places the same models plus a scripted anchor in one shared 20-year world; to our knowledge, the first head-to-head evaluation at this scale. We measure six behavioral capabilities behind the score. Across three seeds, all 15 models complete every horizon while the blind scripted baselines die out in most of theirs, and claude-fable-5 tops the solo board on mean score and the Arena, where the title nonetheless rotates among ten models. Neither scale, price, nor vendor predicts the order; the order settles only late in the horizon, and the best first-play human lands only at the bottom of the model board. What separates the models is managerial behavior rather than computation. Higher-scoring models reduce slow-payoff investment near the end, keep cash invested rather than idle, and open renewals well before the deadline, while token spend predicts nothing. No model learns the market's hidden prices from hundreds of rejected bids, and self-managed memory fails in two opposite modes: an archive that only grows or a plan rewritten every season. Code is available at https://github.com/Analogy-AI/fm-bench.

摘要：語言模型代理現在可以可靠地執行有限的任務。它們是否能在長期內持續有效的決策，尤其是在行動具有累積後果且環境會對其選擇做出反應的情況下，仍然大多未被測量。FM-Bench（足球管理基準）測量這一點。一個LLM代理通過26個工具和大約340到400個決策停頓，運營一個足球俱樂部20個遊戲年。它在與每個對手相同的預算下選擇球隊，交易球員，談判合同，投資設施和青訓，設置陣容，並對一個可以解雇它的董事會負責，同時一個確定性引擎每年累積成一個最終得分，沒有LLM評審或人類評分者。獨立賽道將15個前沿模型與一個凍結的腳本世界進行對抗，而競技場則將相同的模型加上一個腳本錨點放置在一個共享的20年世界中；據我們所知，這是首次在這一規模下進行的正面評估。我們衡量得分背後的六種行為能力。在三個種子中，所有15個模型在每個時間範圍內都完成了任務，而盲目的腳本基線在大多數情況下則無法生存，claude-fable-5在平均得分和競技場上名列獨立榜首，儘管該頭銜在十個模型之間輪流。無論是規模、價格還是供應商都無法預測順序；這一順序僅在時間範圍的後期確定，而最佳的首次遊玩人類僅位於模型榜單的底部。區分這些模型的是管理行為而非計算。得分較高的模型在結尾時減少慢回報的投資，保持現金投資而非閒置，並在截止日期之前提前開啟續約，而代幣支出則無法預測任何結果。沒有模型能從數百個被拒絕的出價中學習市場的隱藏價格，自我管理的記憶在兩種相反的模式中失敗：一個僅增長的檔案或每個賽季重寫的計劃。代碼可在 https://github.com/Analogy-AI/fm-bench 獲取。

docs.title: LEDGER: Claim-to-Evidence Trace Graphs for Auditing LLM Agents
docs.text:
2608.18398v1 by Daehong Kim, Haichao Miao, Shusen Liu

Large language model (LLM) agents can now carry out long-horizon technical workflows involving complex tool use, code execution, file edits, and generated artifacts. As agents do more work faster, the productivity bottleneck shifts from producing outputs to auditing whether those outputs are correct and trustworthy. Agent observability systems make fine-grained execution events visible, but visibility alone still leaves reviewers to reconstruct which actions, artifacts, and validation steps matter for a particular conclusion. We introduce LEDGER - Layered Evidence and Decision Graphs for Execution Review, a tracing and review system that builds layered trace graphs over observed agent sessions. LEDGER preserves Trace Records while grouping them into Evidence Nodes and Workflow Nodes, representing artifacts as evidence anchors, and adding typed semantic edges that connect claims to supporting actions, artifacts, and checks. Through data-analysis and coding examples, we show how the resulting traces expose workflow decisions, artifact lineage, repair steps, validation coverage, and claim-support paths for evidence-centered audit.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLM）代理現在可以執行涉及複雜工具使用、代碼執行、文件編輯和生成產物的長期技術工作流程。隨著代理更快地完成更多工作，生產力瓶頸從產出轉移到審核這些產出是否正確和可信。代理可觀察性系統使得細粒度的執行事件可見，但僅有可見性仍然使審核者需要重建哪些行動、產物和驗證步驟對於特定結論是重要的。我們引入了LEDGER - 分層證據和決策圖，用於執行審核，這是一個在觀察到的代理會話上建立分層追蹤圖的追蹤和審核系統。LEDGER保留追蹤記錄，同時將它們分組為證據節點和工作流程節點，將產物表示為證據錨，並添加類型化的語義邊，將主張連接到支持行動、產物和檢查。通過數據分析和代碼示例，我們展示了結果追蹤如何揭示工作流程決策、產物來源、修復步驟、驗證覆蓋率和支持證據的主張路徑。

docs.title: Figurative and Cultural Knowledge in LLMs: Investigating Cross-Domain Transfer through Fine-Tuning
docs.text:
2608.18361v1 by Mena Attia, Mona Diab, Thamar Solorio

Figurative language is deeply culturally embedded; fluent use requires not just linguistic competence but cultural immersion. We ask whether LLMs can learn this link: does fine-tuning on cultural data improve figurative language understanding, and vice versa? We conduct a systematic study across four models (ALLaM-7B, Fanar-1-9B, Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and six Arabic datasets spanning cultural commonsense, proverbs, and poetry across diverse dialects and regions. Fine-tuning on poetry improves idiom comprehension (+2.33%, p<0.05), a gain our ArabicMMLU control does not reproduce, indicating that it stems from figurative content rather than Arabic language adaptation and pointing to a sensitivity to non-literal meaning that transfers across figurative types. Cultural fine-tuning, by contrast, lowers proverb-interpretation accuracy in both Arabic-centric models. Transfer between the two domains is otherwise indistinguishable from noise, with Arabic models frequently regressing after fine-tuning, suggesting prior saturation of relevant knowledge, while multilingual models show greater adaptation headroom. Error analysis further reveals that fine-tuning reinforces experiential cultural knowledge while destabilizing historically grounded factual knowledge. Our findings suggest that the relationship between culture and figurative language, though conceptually natural, is not straightforwardly captured through fine-tuning alone.

摘要：比喻語言深深植根於文化中；流利的使用不僅需要語言能力，還需要文化浸潤。我們詢問大型語言模型（LLMs）是否能學習這種聯繫：在文化數據上進行微調是否能改善比喻語言的理解，反之亦然？我們對四個模型（ALLaM-7B、Fanar-1-9B、Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B）和六個阿拉伯數據集進行了系統研究，這些數據集涵蓋了跨越不同方言和地區的文化常識、諺語和詩歌。在詩歌上進行微調可以改善成語理解（+2.33%，p<0.05），這一增益我們的阿拉伯MMLU控制組無法重現，表明這是源於比喻內容而非阿拉伯語適應，並指出對非字面意義的敏感性在不同比喻類型之間轉移。相比之下，文化微調在兩個以阿拉伯為中心的模型中降低了諺語解釋的準確性。兩個領域之間的轉移在其他方面與噪聲無法區分，阿拉伯模型在微調後經常出現退步，這表明相關知識的先前飽和，而多語言模型則顯示出更大的適應空間。錯誤分析進一步揭示，微調強化了經驗性的文化知識，同時使歷史基礎的事實知識不穩定。我們的研究結果表明，儘管文化與比喻語言之間的關係在概念上是自然的，但僅通過微調並不能簡單地捕捉到這一點。

docs.title: Measuring the Partial-Credit Gap: A Strict Benchmark on Vietnam's 2025 Convex Marking Scheme
docs.text:
2608.18336v1 by Nguyen Quoc Hung, Nguyen Dang Minh, Le Nhu Quynh, Tran Khanh Linh, Nguyen Kieu Linh

When evaluating language models on human exams, benchmarks typically score each response as right or wrong and report the overall accuracy. This approach assumes that partial knowledge is worth proportional credit, an assumption that fails when an examination uses a non-additive grading scheme. The 2025 reform of Vietnam's National High School Graduation Examination demonstrates the cost of this substitution. In Part II of the exam, candidates evaluate four true/false statements per question. The grading is convex: the number of correct statements earns 0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, or 1.00 points. Identifying three statements correctly pays 0.50 points, not the 0.75 points that standard accuracy metrics would award. Because Part II accounts for 4.00 of the exam's 10.00 points, reporting accuracy inflates the score by rewarding partial knowledge that the state explicitly penalizes. We introduce THPT-Ladder, a benchmark of 632 items from 21 official exams across 11 subjects, graded exactly as the ministry grades its students. The ministry publishes the marks of over a million candidates, allowing us to place models directly into the human cohort.
